import subprocess
import os
import sys
from scipy import stats

phykit = "/workspace/venv/bin/phykit"

def get_rcv_scores(msa_dir):
    scores = []
    errors = []
    for fname in sorted(os.listdir(msa_dir)):
        if not fname.endswith('.mafft'):
            continue
        fpath = os.path.join(msa_dir, fname)
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [phykit, 'rcv', fpath],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60
            )
            if result.returncode != 0:
                errors.append((fname, result.stderr.strip()))
                continue
            rcv_val = float(result.stdout.strip())
            scores.append((fname.replace('.faa.mafft', ''), rcv_val))
        except Exception as e:
            errors.append((fname, str(e)))
    return scores, errors

print("Computing animal RCV scores...")
animal_scores, animal_errs = get_rcv_scores("/workspace/tmp_animals")
print(f"  Got {len(animal_scores)} scores, {len(animal_errs)} errors")

print("Computing fungal RCV scores...")
fungal_scores, fungal_errs = get_rcv_scores("/workspace/tmp_fungi")
print(f"  Got {len(fungal_scores)} scores, {len(fungal_errs)} errors")

if animal_errs:
    print(f"Animal errors (first 5): {animal_errs[:5]}")
if fungal_errs:
    print(f"Fungal errors (first 5): {fungal_errs[:5]}")

# Print summary stats
animal_vals = [s[1] for s in animal_scores]
fungal_vals = [s[1] for s in fungal_scores]

print(f"\nAnimal RCV: n={len(animal_vals)}, mean={sum(animal_vals)/len(animal_vals):.4f}, min={min(animal_vals):.4f}, max={max(animal_vals):.4f}")
print(f"Fungal RCV: n={len(fungal_vals)}, mean={sum(fungal_vals)/len(fungal_vals):.4f}, min={min(fungal_vals):.4f}, max={max(fungal_vals):.4f}")

# Mann-Whitney U test
stat, p_value = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"\nMann-Whitney U test: statistic={stat}, p-value={p_value}")

# Also print with more precision
print(f"p-value (full precision): {p_value:.15e}")
PYEOF

from scipy import stats

# Reconstruct from the scores
import subprocess, os

phykit = "/workspace/venv/bin/phykit"

animal_vals = []
for fname in sorted(os.listdir("/workspace/tmp_animals")):
    if fname.endswith('.mafft'):
        r = subprocess.run([phykit, 'rcv', f"/workspace/tmp_animals/{fname}"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        animal_vals.append(float(r.stdout.strip()))

fungal_vals = []
for fname in sorted(os.listdir("/workspace/tmp_fungi")):
    if fname.endswith('.mafft'):
        r = subprocess.run([phykit, 'rcv', f"/workspace/tmp_fungi/{fname}"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        fungal_vals.append(float(r.stdout.strip()))

print(f"Animals: n={len(animal_vals)}, mean={sum(animal_vals)/len(animal_vals):.6f}")
print(f"Fungi:   n={len(fungal_vals)}, mean={sum(fungal_vals)/len(fungal_vals):.6f}")

# Test with different settings
# Default: use_continuity=True, method='auto' (asymptotic), alternative='two-sided'
s1, p1 = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"\nDefault (continuity=True, two-sided):  U={s1}, p={p1:.15e}")

s2, p2 = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='two-sided', use_continuity=False)
print(f"No continuity correction, two-sided: U={s2}, p={p2:.15e}")

s3, p3 = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='greater')
print(f"Continuity=True, greater:            U={s3}, p={p3:.15e}")

s4, p4 = stats.mannwhitneyu(animal_vals, fungal_vals, alternative='less')
print(f"Continuity=True, less:               U={s4}, p={p4:.15e}")
